A howl goes up, and the pack answers!
A roar echoes, and more of them come!

phases.message: Morvoct, the goblin warlord rages, and the fight turns deadlier!

abilities.name: Fury
abilities.telegraph: Morvoct, the goblin warlord gathers itself for a sweeping assault!

abilities.name: Crushing Blow
abilities.telegraph: Morvoct, the goblin warlord raises a killing blow at you!

abilities.name: Doom
abilities.telegraph: Morvoct, the goblin warlord begins something terrible!

799910.name: sea king merman lord
799910.short_desc: the Sea King, a merman lord
799910.long_desc: The Sea King sits upon his throne of twisted coral, a golden trident across his knees.
799910.description: A merman lord of great size, his scales the blue-green of deep water and his beard braided with pearls. A crown of coral and gold sits on his brow. The merman guards of this hall answer to him, and he does not forgive those who come uninvited into his court.
799910.why: the Sea King on his throne

phases.message: The Sea King rises from the throne: "To me, my guard!"

abilities.name: Tidal Surge
abilities.telegraph: The Sea King lifts his trident, and the water in the air surges!

abilities.name: Trident Thrust
abilities.telegraph: The Sea King drives his trident at you!

abilities.name: Call of the Deep
abilities.telegraph: The Sea King begins a long, low song of the deep!

799911.name: harpy queen
799911.long_desc: The harpy queen perches on the rim of her nest, shrieking into the wind.
799911.description: Larger than the matrons who serve her, with a crown of gull feathers and a face that was once beautiful. Her talons are hooked like a fisherman's gaff, and the shiny things scattered round the nest are hers.
799911.why: the harpy queen in her nest

patrols.why: a salt-stained goblin walks its ground

bosses.why: Morvoct, the goblin warlord in its lair

mechanics.shout: Morvoct, the goblin warlord calls for help!

bosses.why: the Sea King on his throne

mechanics.shout: The Sea King strikes the dais with his trident: "Guards!"

bosses.why: the harpy queen in her nest
